title: SAN-881 calibration reveal-verification ledger
description: Canonical record of which sealed envelopes were revealed and verified, at which stage of the staged-adjudication workflow. Filename: reveal_verification_ledger.json. Bound into FREEZE-MANIFEST.json by reveal_verification_ledger_sha256. Canonical encoding: sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii, single trailing LF. Entry ORDER is PINNED index-by-index (SAN-881 Phase-A correction item 2) to the literal canonical sequence below via prefixItems -- the ledger builder EMITS this order directly, it does not sort by (envelope, artifact_name); reversal or any other permutation fails this schema.

entries.description: EXACTLY six entries, in this EXACT pinned order (SAN-881 Phase-A correction): (1) labels_author_semantic.json/author/semantic, (2) labels_reviewer_semantic.json/reviewer_semantic/semantic, (3) labels_author_contract.json/author/contract, (4) design_metadata.json/author/contract, (5) coverage_manifest.json/author/contract, (6) labels_reviewer_contract.json/reviewer_contract/contract. The literal (artifact_name, envelope, verified_stage) tuple set AND order are additionally pinned and cross-checked by validate_design.check_reveal_verification_ledger / validate_design.LEDGER_CANONICAL_ORDER.
